page 10". It concerns the draft as a whole. The program officer decides the answer and records it before the draft can be signed.

Rule R1 (added by the team) refers every other child to a health facility as the most urgent result. Is that the right handling? It concerns R1, outside_age_range. The program officer decides the answer and records it before the draft can be signed.
